question.text: The SEQUENCE of key steps to launch a Cat III AIF as a trust is:

answer.text: (1) Draft Trust Deed and appoint trustee; (2) Execute IMA with manager; (3) File PPM with SEBI via merchant banker and obtain AIF registration; (4) Build the investor book and begin deployment, with capital called only after registration is in place
(1) Solicit investor commitments; (2) File PPM; (3) Draft Trust Deed; (4) Execute IMA
(1) SEBI grants registration; (2) Draft Trust Deed; (3) Solicit investors; (4) Execute IMA
(1) File PPM only; (2) Everything else executed post-launch

explanation.text: The Logic: The general sequence is: Trust Deed and trustee appointment, then IMA with the manager, then PPM filing with SEBI through the merchant banker and AIF registration, and then building the investor book and deployment. The workbook permits accepting investor commitments after in-principle approval, but capital should not be called until registration is in place. The Trap: Other sequences invert dependencies among the trust, IMA, registration, and investor steps. Note: The workbook (pp. 100, 124, 235, 390) supports the launch components (trust deed, trustee, IMA, merchant-banker PPM filing) and the registration/commitment sequencing described here.
